Properties 390-420: 3D Transforms, Gradient Masks, and Row Rules

Properties added after baseline 389 · CSS Transforms, Masking, and Gap Rules · font-family "Liberation Sans"

PROPS-390-TO-420

Audit of CSS properties and features implemented after baseline 389. Rows cover WebKit 3D prefix aliases, multi-axis 3D transform functions, gradient and image-set masks, and row/universal gap rules. Each row features an imperative specification and a live visual Effect demo.

# Property What it should do Effect (live)

legacy-vendor-alias · CSS Transforms · Chrome yes
